notes: A clock on the network copy of the talent screen (/prompter): the time of day, with seconds, on the show's clock (the caller's, or the prompter Mac's straight from it). Drag it anywhere; drag its corner to make it bigger or smaller. Each screen keeps its own place and size. C hides it, or add `?clock=0` to the link. It's never mirrored and never shows on the talent's own screen.
